notes.title: Switchblade Rename - Version 1.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This is a bit sudden, but Switchblade has had to be renamed. I was aware that the game shared the name of another game called Switchblade for some time, but was under the impression it wouldn't be an issue because this one is so much smaller. However, I've since been made aware that THAT Switchblade is actually trademarked, so to avoid any legal trouble I've renamed the game to Blade Rush. Some of you have been aware of this issue for some time, as I've been slowly renaming the game in other locations.

Saves should still work. The game will move your save over to the new location, and if something messes up, the save before starting the new update will still be available under Switchblade in the typical directory (%AppData%/Roaming). That folder will not be deleted, so you may want to clean it up yourself.

I also have a bug fix, so here is a changelog.

- Updated all names of Switchblade to refer to Blade Rush, or just Blade (if referring to the ship).
- Fixed a bug where dying in the same frame that a Redirector grabs you would cause a crash.
- Updated Switchblade logo to Blade Rush logo.
- Updated saving directory to blade-rush.

Please, if you notice any bugs or issues or places where the old name persists, don't hesitate to let me know! It's been a long process to get the game renamed and updated, so fingers crossed I didn't miss anything. Thanks!

notes.title: Switchblade - Version 1.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Here's a build to address some balancing changes.


Added a grace period after [spoiler]teleporting either by the teleporter hazard or enemy[/spoiler], so that you can't accidentally run into pickups.
Made the map for One Big Minefield a little easier. The goal with that map was to introduce the Wall hazard and try to incentivise being aware of your surroundings, but it was too claustrophobic and harsh for that early in the game. I've updated it to try and keep that design, but make it less punishing.

notes.title: Switchblade - Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
Here is a quick hotfix for version 1.1:


Fixed a bug where getting any S rank after completing the campaign would grant the Perfectionist achievement.
Fixed a bug where selecting a campaign level, going to the ability screen, then returning would disable leaderboards until you reset mutators, or back out of the campaign menu.

notes.title: Switchblade - Version 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The response to Switchblade has been great to see so far. Thank you so much! Here is a build to address some feedback I've received in the past day.


Fixed leaderboards not showing a failure notification when offline.
Added mutators to the campaign menu. They will disable leaderboards and ranks.
Fixed Drones (or Chargers, or Chompers...) beginning a charge in one direction, but actually charging in a different direction.
Added music fading between game states.
Improved visibility of the controls in the bottom left, mainly to make it more obvious that there is a quick restart feature.
Improved the effect when a Shielder destroys a bullet.
Updated the credits to add a missing name.
Added alt subtitles to all bosses, so they will pick one out of a random pool per boss.
Updated help popup of Blast to make it a little less confusing.

notes.title: Switchblade is out!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Switchblade is now released after a year in development! I hope it was worth the wait and that you enjoy it.

So what now?

I'm going to take a much needed break, and after maybe a week or so push a build for bug fixes or feedback I may have missed. I may have small plans for additional features in the future, but I'm not going to announce anything in case I can't deliver.

Thanks,
Noba

notes.title: Switchblade Demo - Version 1.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As promised, here is a new build including all of the previously given demo feedback. I think I promised that anyway, I forget if I even mentioned it. Either way here it is!

Unfortunately, save files had to be reset for this update. This doesn't affect your leaderboard scores on Steam, though.

Changelog is incomplete as there was just that much stuff to go through.

Changelog
Added events and ability explanations to the tutorial.
Improved "reset defaults" button in the options, and fixed tooltip bugs.
Added better ability feedback in game, so it's 100% clear when an ability is charged.
Remade the in game UI to have more useful information. It now shows the target score on the left, which is either your current score if the max is reached, a challenge rank, or your leaderboard score based on certain conditions. It also works with the offline leaderboards.
Improved difficulty level display (level up/level down text relates to this), so it's clear what it means and what the current level is.
Added a bunch of colour all over the UI, looks less boring and is easier to tell what's what from a glance.
Did a pass over the boss health bar and the boss intro cards. They were some of the oldest UI elements in the game, so they needed some love.
Dying will flash the enemy that caused your death in colour, so that it's always 100% clear what hit you.
Improved several enemy behaviours to make them less of a pain to deal with, or just more interesting. You'll probably see most of these in Freeplay if you get that far.
Fixed a couple of crashes (I hope).
Added trigger input binding to the control settings. Currently only supports boost and shoot, if you want something else let me know.
Removed some old/unused menu settings.
Lowered default master volume to 75%.
Replaced freeze frames with time dilation/time scale.
A couple of campaign levels have seen minor changes as part of the main game campaign pass. Diversion especially has been completely redesigned.
Lots of other minor tweaks and changes.


As a thanks for all the feedback on the demo, I've added Surge to the freeplay menu. Have fun!

Thanks,
Noba

notes.title: Switchblade Demo - Version 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The response to the demo has been staggering. I'm so grateful to everyone who checked it out and gave feedback, whether positive or negative. Thank you so much!

While work continues on the main build, most feedback here will be prioritised for that version of the game. However, I decided to push a build today to address a major issue, and a couple of small requested features.

Changelog
Fixed the leaderboard renderer to show all of the scores properly. It also now has some extra info so you know which mode you're looking at.
Reset defaults button is more intuitive. It doesn't reset instantly, doesn't deafen you when you press it, and option hud elements will actually respond to the reset changes.
There is now an options menu in the pause menu. Wow!


I'm slowly working through the feedback and seeing how to address it in the main game. I hope I can deliver!

Thanks,
Noba
